title: Find the Closest Pair of Keys from Two Binary Search Trees
problemStatement: Given the roots of two Binary Search Trees and a target value X, determine one key from each tree whose sum is closest to X.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first BST. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second BST. • The last line contains X.
output: • Print the required pair of keys.
